DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 財布の届け出ですね。中には何が入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're reporting a wallet. What was inside it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 現金と私のカードのほかに、母の診察券が一枚入っています。母の名前の物も私の財布の中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布に母の診察券も含まれると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Along with cash and my cards, there is one of my mother's patient cards. The item in my mother's name is also inside my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the wallet also contains your mother's patient card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その診察券を持っていた事情を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me why you had that patient card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明日の付き添いで使うため、母から預かりました。財布自体は私の物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 付き添い用に母から預かった経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My mother gave it to me to keep because I will be accompanying her tomorrow. The wallet itself is mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother entrusted it to you for accompanying her. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身のカードには、どのようなお名前が載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: What name appears on your own cards?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの身分証と同じ名前です。母とは姓が違うので、二人分の名前を区別して伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人カードと母の異なる姓を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The same name as on this ID. My mother and I have different surnames, so I want to distinguish the two names when giving them to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the name on your own cards from your mother's different surname. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、ご自身のお名前とお母様のお名前を、それぞれ伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please tell me your name and your mother's name separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この欄へ私の名前、隣へ母の名前を書きます。母の診察券だけが別名義です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人の名義を別欄へ記すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write my name in this field and my mother's in the one beside it. Only my mother's patient card is in a different name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the two names in separate fields. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、財布を見分ける特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there any other features that would identify the wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 茶色で、留め具の横に小さな傷があります。二つ折りですが、傷は開かなくても見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 茶色二つ折りと留め具脇の傷を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's brown, with a small scratch beside the clasp. It's a bifold wallet, but you can see the scratch without opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the brown bifold wallet and the scratch beside the clasp. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お財布の特徴と、お母様の診察券が入っていたことを記録します。それでは、届け出の続きを伺います。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record the wallet's features and that it contained your mother's patient card. Now I'll ask for the remaining details of your report. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒が二通ございますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two envelopes, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母と兄へ別々に送ります。中身を取り違えたかもしれないので、出す前に確認してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母と兄への二通を差出前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending them separately to my mother and older brother. I may have mixed up the contents, so may I check before posting them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the two envelopes for your mother and older brother before posting them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、ご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't accepted them yet, so please check them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母への手紙に兄の写真が入っていました。写真だけ兄の封筒へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄の写真を兄宛て封筒へ移すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My older brother's photo was in the letter to my mother. I'll move just the photo to my brother's envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will move your older brother's photo to the envelope addressed to him. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛名も、確認してから封をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the addresses before sealing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母の住所は手帳で確認しました。兄は引っ越したので、古い住所の封筒は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母の住所確認と兄の旧住所を使わない判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I checked my mother's address in my notebook. My older brother has moved, so I won't use the envelope with his old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you checked your mother's address and decided not to use your older brother's old address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい封筒をご用意なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you prepare a new envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ってきた無地の封筒へ兄の新しい住所を書きます。古い封筒は自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新封筒へ新住所を書き旧封筒を持帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write my older brother's new address on the plain envelope I brought. I'll take the old envelope home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the new address on a new envelope and take the old one home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二通の準備ができましたら、お声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know when both envelopes are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。写真は兄へ、手紙だけは母へ入れて、別々に封をしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 中身を区別して二通に封をしたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've finished writing. I put the photo in my older brother's envelope and only the letter in my mother's, and sealed them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you separated the contents and sealed the two envelopes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれお預かりして送付方法を確認します。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll accept each one and check how you would like to send them. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記帳された通帳について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the entries printed in your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて使うので、左右の数字の見方を教えてください。入ったお金はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通帳の入金欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's my first time using it, so please explain how to read the figures on the left and right. Which side shows money coming in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which column in the passbook shows deposits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通帳では「お預り金額」の欄が入金です。「お支払金額」は出金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this passbook, the amount deposited column shows money coming in. The amount paid out column shows money going out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この振込はお預り金額にあるので、入金なのですね。残高の数字とは別だと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入金と残高が別欄と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This transfer is in the amount deposited column, so it's money coming in. I understand that it is separate from the balance figure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand deposits and the balance appear in separate columns. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。残高は、そのお取引後の金額です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The balance is the amount remaining after that transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の給料を探しています。会社の名前があるこの行について確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 給与と思われる会社名の行を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm looking for yesterday's salary payment. I'd like to check this row with the company's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the row with the company name that you think is your salary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示された会社名と日付を、ご自身の給与資料と照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please compare the company name and date shown with your own salary documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 給与明細は家にあります。ここで給料と決め付けず、帰って日付と金額を比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅明細で日付金額を照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My payslip is at home. I won't assume here that it's my salary; I'll compare the date and amount when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the date and amount with your payslip at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明なお取引が残りましたら、窓口へお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If any transactions remain unclear, please ask at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その時は該当する行を伝えます。通帳へ書き込みはせず、気になる日付だけ自分のノートへ控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明行の日付を別ノートへ控え後で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll tell you which row it is. I won't write in the passbook; I'll note just the dates that concern me in my own notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the date of the unclear row in a separate notebook and ask about it later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通帳をお返しします。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your passbook back. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 回収機について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the collection machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。空の飲み物の容器を持ってきました。缶もこの機械へ入れられると思いましたが、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参空き缶を回収機に入れられるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I brought some empty drink containers. I thought cans could also go into this machine, but I'd like to check first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the empty cans you brought can go into the collection machine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは指定のペットボトル用です。缶はこの機械へ入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This machine is for designated PET bottles. Please do not put cans in it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ入れていません。缶を押し込んで認識させようとするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入で缶を押込まないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't put any in yet. I won't try to force a can in to make the machine recognize it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not inserted any cans and will not force them in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちなのは、缶だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you only have cans with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 缶が三つです。家で袋へまとめましたが、ペットボトルは入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 缶三つのみでPETなしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three cans. I put them together in a bag at home, but there are no PET bottles in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only three cans and no PET bottles. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場所では缶を回収していません。ほかの箱にも、表示を確認せず入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't collect cans here. Please don't put them in any other bin without checking its label either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は缶を持ち帰ります。店のごみ箱へ買物のごみと混ぜて置いて帰るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店のごみ箱に混ぜず缶を持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take the cans home today. I don't intend to mix them with shopping rubbish in the shop's bins and leave them there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the cans home without mixing them into the shop's rubbish bins. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自宅の地域の回収案内などを、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your local area's collection guidance, for example.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その案内で出せる日を見ます。缶は元の袋に戻し、機械の前を空けて買物へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地域回収日確認と袋回収後機械前を空けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look in that guidance for the days I can put them out. I'll return the cans to the original bag, clear the area in front of the machine, and go shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check local collection days and clear the front of the machine after picking up your bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、お買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 向こうにリードの付いていない犬がいます。犬が怖いので、あちらを通れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 放たれた犬への恐怖と通れない事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a dog without a leash over there. I'm afraid of dogs, so I can't go that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are afraid of the loose dog and cannot pass that way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 近付かず、ここでお待ちください。飼い主らしい方はいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait here without going near it. Was there anyone who seemed to be its owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 周りを見ましたが、犬を呼んでいる人はいませんでした。私から触ったりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飼主不明と非接触を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I looked around, but no one was calling the dog. I haven't touched it or approached it to do so.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the owner is unknown and you have not touched the dog. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの辺りで見掛けましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水飲み場の後ろです。今は低い植え込みの横にいます。子どもが近くを歩いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 犬の現在位置と近くの子どもを知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Behind the drinking fountain. It's now beside the low shrubs. There are children walking nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the dog's current location and the children nearby. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 職員へ連絡します。あなたは管理棟の方へ移っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll contact the staff. Could you move toward the administration building?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、犬のいる方とは反対なので移れます。子どものことも職員の方へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 反対側へ移動し子どもの情報の伝達を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I can move there because it's in the opposite direction from the dog. Please tell the staff about the children too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will move in the opposite direction and ask them to pass on the information about the children. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡しました。犬の様子は職員が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've contacted them. The staff will check on the dog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私は管理棟前で待ちます。様子を見に戻らず、帰る道が通れるか後で尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 近付かず管理棟前で帰路相談を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait in front of the administration building. I won't go back to look, and I'll ask later whether I can use the route home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay away and wait in front of the administration building to ask about your route home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらでお待ちください。お知らせありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here, then. Thank you for letting us know. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様とご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you travelling with your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。階段の方で大きな音がして、子どもが列車の故障だと思っています。何の音か分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子が工事音を列車故障と心配し音源を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There was a loud noise near the stairs, and my child thinks the train has broken down. Do you know what the noise is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child is worried the construction noise means a train breakdown, and ask where the sound comes from. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の音は階段付近の工事の作業音です。立入表示のある所には近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That was construction work near the stairs. Please stay away from areas with restricted-entry signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 工事の音なのですね。子どもにそう説明します。この辺りより音の小さい場所で待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音源を理解し静かな待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's construction noise. I'll explain that to my child. Can we wait somewhere quieter than here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the source of the sound and ask for a quiet place to wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 音から離れてお待ちになるなら、こちら側が使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use this side if you want to wait farther from the noise.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらへ移ります。子どもが怖がっているので、列車を待つ間は手をつないでいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 静かな待機側へ移り子と手をつなぐと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll move over here. My child is frightened, so I'd like to hold their hand while we wait for the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will move to the quieter side to wait and hold your child's hand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の列車は、表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the display for the next train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもには、ここで手をつないで次の列車を待とうと言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 列車表示を確認し子に一緒に待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I'll tell my child, let's hold hands here and wait for the next train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the train display and tell your child to wait together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からないことがあれば、またお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask again if there's anything you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。音の理由を説明できました。乗る時も急がせず、降りる方を待ってから一緒に乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 音源理解後も降車優先で子と乗車すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I was able to explain the reason for the noise. When we board, I won't rush my child, and we'll wait for people to get off before getting on together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that, after understanding the noise, you will still let people get off first before boarding with your child. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけてご乗車ください。それでは、よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care when boarding. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の会議についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the community meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今度初めて参加します。長い日本語で話すのは難しいですが、一つだけ意見を伝えてみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初会議で短く一意見を伝えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll be attending for the first time. Speaking at length in Japanese is difficult, but I'd like to try sharing just one opinion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sharing one brief opinion at your first meeting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どんな内容をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you have in mind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ごみ拾いの日に、終わった後で道具を洗う場所が分かりませんでした。次回は最初に案内してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道具洗場の事前案内を希望する理由を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the litter-picking day, I didn't know where to wash the tools afterward. Next time I'd like someone to explain that at the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you would like advance guidance on where to wash the tools. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の経験と、次回の希望を分けて伝えると分かりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It will be clearer if you separate your experience from what you would like next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では「前回は道具を洗う場所が分からなかったので、次回は最初に教えてください」と言ってみます。これで伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 経験と希望を一文で言い伝わるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll try saying, last time I didn't know where to wash the tools, so please tell us at the start next time. Does that get my meaning across?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put your experience and request in one sentence and check that it is understandable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、どの場所の話か分かります。発言する順番は、当日の担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it is clear which place you mean. Please ask the person in charge that day about the order of speakers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に紙へ短く書き、発言の順番が来たら読みます。途中で言葉が止まっても、最後まで言いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短文準備し発言順に途中停止しても最後まで読むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll write it briefly on paper first and read it when it's my turn. Even if I get stuck partway through, I'd like to finish saying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare a short text and read to the end when your turn comes, even if you pause partway through. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 練習しておくのもよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would be good to practise beforehand too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで一度読んでもいいですか。聞いた人が場所の話だと分かるよう、「道具を洗う場所」を省かず読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所名を省かず練習読上げを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: May I read it here once? I'll read the words where to wash the tools without leaving them out, so listeners understand that I'm talking about a place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to practise reading it aloud without omitting the description of the place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容は伝わりますよ。当日の担当にもご相談ください。それでは、準備を頑張ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your meaning comes across. Please also consult the person in charge that day. Good luck with your preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お呼びした時、お返事がなかったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: It seems you didn't answer when we called you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。椅子で眠ってしまいました。外へ出ていたのではありません。今からどうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合で居眠し未応答だったと説明して手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sorry. I fell asleep in the chair. I hadn't gone outside. What should I do now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you missed the call because you dozed off in the waiting area, and ask what to do. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付の状況を確認します。お名前と受付票を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your registration status. Please show me your name and registration slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエンです。この票です。呼ばれた時刻は分かりませんが、眠る前はここに座っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名受付票を示し呼出時刻不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm Nguyen. Here's my slip. I don't know what time you called me, but I was sitting here before I fell asleep.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your name and registration slip and say that you don't know the time you were called. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状況を確認するので、この場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the situation, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらで待ちます。私の診察がまだこれからか、今の順番と一緒に確認して教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診察の状態と現在の順番の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait here. Please check whether my consultation is still to come, along with my current place in the queue, and let me know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the status of your consultation and your current place in the queue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後にご案内します。体調で気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll guide you after checking. Is there anything about your health that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨夜あまり眠れなかったことを先生に話したいです。いつから眠気があるか、自分の言葉で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨夜睡眠不足と眠気経過を医師へ伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to tell the doctor that I didn't sleep much last night. I'll explain in my own words when the drowsiness started.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell the doctor about last night's lack of sleep and the course of your drowsiness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も診察でお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please mention that during your consultation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。次は呼出しに気づけるよう、この席で姿勢を起こして待ちます。つらくなったら声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 起きて呼出を待ちつらければ知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll sit upright in this seat while waiting so that I notice the next call. I'll let you know if I start feeling unwell.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay awake waiting for the call and let someone know if you feel unwell. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一度受付の記録を確認してきます。戻りましたらお声がけします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll go and check the reception records. I'll speak to you when I return. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでお話を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I hear what happened here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し待ってください。怒った気持ちのままで、声が大きくなりそうです。相手を怒鳴るために来たのではなく、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 高ぶり大声の恐れがあり相談前待機を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please wait a moment. I'm still angry, and I feel I might raise my voice. I didn't come to shout at the other person; I'd like advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are upset and might speak loudly, and ask to wait before discussing the matter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 落ち着いて話せるよう、まずこちらへお座りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please sit here first so you can talk calmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。少し座ってから話したいです。今は息を整える時間をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座って息を整える時間を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I'd like to sit for a little while before talking. Please give me time to steady my breathing now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for time to sit and steady your breathing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お話しできるようになったら、分かることから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When you feel able to talk, I'll listen, starting with what you can tell me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。最初は何が起きたかを話し、その後でどうしたいかを伝えます。気持ちと出来事を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 事実後希望の順で感情出来事を分けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll start by explaining what happened, then say what I'd like to do. I want to separate my feelings from the events.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to separate feelings from events, explaining the facts first and your wishes afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 急がず、ご自身の言葉でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Take your time and speak in your own words.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し落ち着きました。途中で声が強くなったら、いったん止めてよいかも確認しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 落着後途中で強声なら休止可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've calmed down a little. I'd also like to check whether I can pause if my voice becomes forceful partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After calming down, ask whether you can pause if your voice becomes forceful during the conversation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、途中でもいったん休めます。休みたい時はお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can take a break even partway through. Please tell me when you want to rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。少し休むと話せそうです。五分ほどたったら、もう一度声をかけてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五分ほど休んでから再び声をかけてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I think I'll be able to talk after a short rest. Could you speak to me again in about five minutes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to speak to you again after a rest of about five minutes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。少しお休みください。五分ほどで戻ります。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please rest for a while. I'll return in about five minutes. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手紙をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send a letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、便箋の間に買い物のメモが入っているかもしれません。まだ封をしていないので、ここで確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未封手紙の混入メモを自分で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But there might be a shopping note between the sheets of writing paper. I haven't sealed it yet, so may I check here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the unsealed letter yourself for an accidentally included note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの台で、ご自身で中をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the contents yourself at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見つかりました。この小さい紙は相手への手紙ではありません。抜いて自分の財布へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 買物メモを抜き財布へ入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I found it. This small piece of paper isn't part of the letter to the recipient. I'll remove it and put it in my own wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will remove the shopping note and put it in your wallet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お送りになる便箋は、そろいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are all the sheets you want to send there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 便箋は二枚そろっています。上から順に読めるよう、重ね直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便箋二枚の順番を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both sheets are here. I've stacked them again so they can be read in order from the top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the order of the two sheets of writing paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で確認できましたら、封をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have checked them yourself, please seal the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メモを抜いたので、これで封をします。のりを使える場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混入メモを取り除き封をするためののりを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've removed the note, so I'll seal it now. Is there somewhere I can use glue?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you removed the accidentally included note and ask for glue to seal the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この台ののりをご利用ください。閉じましたら宛先もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the glue on this counter. Once you have closed it, check the address too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛先と便箋二枚を確かめました。買い物メモは財布にあります。封をしたので、この手紙をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先便箋と私物メモ所在を確認し差出依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the address and both sheets of writing paper. The shopping note is in my wallet. I've sealed it, so please send this letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the address, writing paper, and location of your personal note, and ask to post the letter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをお預かりします。それでは、ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take this from you. Thank you for using our service.
